an5.180:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
an5.180:1.2: Addasā kho Bhagavā addhānamaggapaṭipanno aññatarasmiṃ padese mahantaṃ sālavanaṃ,
an5.180:1.3: disvā maggā okkamma yena taṃ sālavanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ sālavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ padese sitaṃ pātvākāsi.
an5.180:2.1: Atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi
an5.180:2.2: ‘ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo Bhagavato sitassa pātukammāya?
an5.180:2.3: Na akāraṇena Tathāgatā sitaṃ pātukarontī' ti.
an5.180:2.4: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: --
an5.180:2.5: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo Bhagavato sitassa pātukammāya?
an5.180:2.6: Na akāraṇena Tathāgatā sitaṃ pātukarontī ti. 2.
an5.180:3.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ Ānanda imasmiṃ padese nagaraṃ ahosi iddhañ c'eva phītañ ca bahujanaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ.
an5.180:3.2: Taṃ kho pan' Ānanda nagaraṃ Kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho upanissāya vihāsi.
an5.180:3.3: Kassapassa kho pan' Ānanda bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Gavesī nāma upāsako ahosi sīlesu aparipūrakārī.
an5.180:3.4: Gavesinā kho Ānanda upāsakena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭidesitāni samādapitāni ahesuṃ sīlesu aparipūrakārino.
an5.180:3.5: Atha kho Ānanda Gavesissa upāsakassa etad ahosi
an5.180:3.6: ‘ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā ahañ c' amhi sīlesu aparipūrakārī imāni ca pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu aparipūrakārino.
an5.180:4.1: Atha kho Ānanda Gavesī upāsako yena tāni pañca upāsakasatāni ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā tāni pañca upāsakasatāni etad avoca:--
an5.180:4.2: Ajjatagge maṃ āyasmanto sīlesu paripūrakāriṃ dhārethā ti.
an5.180:4.3: Atha kho Ānanda tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etad ahosi
an5.180:4.4: ‘ayyo kho Gavesī amhākaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā,
an5.180:4.5: ayyo hi nāma Gavesī sīlesu paripūrakārī bhavissati,
an5.180:4.7: Atha kho Ānanda tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena Gavesī upāsako ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Gavesiṃ upāsakaṃ etad avocuṃ:--
an5.180:4.8: Ajjatagge ayyo Gavesī imāni pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu paripūrakārino dhāretū ti.
an5.180:4.9: Atha kho Ānanda Gavesissa upāsakassa etad ahosi
an5.180:4.10: ‘ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā ahañ c' amhi sīlesu paripūrakārī imām ca pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu paripūrakārino.
an5.180:5.1: Atha kho Ānanda Gavesī upāsako yena tāni pañca upāsakasatāni ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā tāni pañca upāsakasatāni etad avoca:--
an5.180:5.2: Ajjatagge maṃ āyasmanto brahmacāriṃ dhāretha ārācāriṃ virataṃ methunā gāmadhammā ti.
an5.180:5.3: Atha kho Ānanda tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etad ahosi
an5.180:5.4: ‘ayyo kho Gavesī amhākaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā,
an5.180:5.5: ayyo hi nāma Gavesī brahmacārī bhavissati ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā,
an5.180:5.7: Atha kho Ānanda tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena Gavesī upāsako ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Gavesiṃ upāsakaṃ etad avocuṃ:--
an5.180:5.8: Ajjatagge ayyo Gavesī imāni pi pañca upāsakasatāni brahmacārino dhāretu ārācārino virate methunā gāmadhammā ti.
an5.180:5.9: Atha kho Ānanda Gavesissa upāsakassa etad ahosi
an5.180:5.10: ‘ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā
an5.180:5.12: imāni pi pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu paripūrakārino,
an5.180:5.13: ahañ c' amhi brahmacārī ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā,
an5.180:5.14: imāni pi pañca upāsakasatāni brahmacārino ārācārino viratā methunā gāmadhammā.
an5.180:6.1: Atha kho Ānanda Gavesī upāsako yena tāni pañca upāsakasatāni ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā tāni pañca upāsakasatāni etad avoca:--
an5.180:6.2: Ajjatagge maṃ āyasmanto ekabhattikaṃ dhāretha rattūparataṃ virataṃ vikālabhojanā ti.
an5.180:6.3: Atha kho Ānanda tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etad ahosi
an5.180:6.4: ‘ayyo kho Gavesī amhākaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā,
an5.180:6.5: ayyo hi nāma Gavesī ekabhattiko bhavissati rattūparato virato vikālabhojanā,
an5.180:6.7: Atha kho Ānanda tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena Gavesī upāsako ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Gavesiṃ upāsakaṃ etad avocuṃ: --
an5.180:6.8: Ajjatagge ayyo Gavesī imāni pi pañca upāsakasatāni ekabhattike dhāretu rattūparate virate vikālabhojanā ti.
an5.180:6.9: Atha kho Ānanda Gavesissa upāsakassa etad ahosi
an5.180:6.10: ‘ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā
an5.180:6.12: imāni pi pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu paripūrakārino,
an5.180:6.13: ahañ c' amhi brahmacārī ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā,
an5.180:6.14: imāni pi pañca upāsakasatāni brahmacārino ārācārino viratā methunā gāmadhammā,
an5.180:6.15: ahañ c' amhi ekabhattiko rattūparato virato vikālabhojanā,
an5.180:6.16: imāni pi pañca upāsakasatāni ekabhattikā rattūparatā viratā vikālabhojanā.
an5.180:7.1: Atha kho Ānanda Gavesī upāsako yena Kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Kassapaṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etad avoca:--
an5.180:7.2: Labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan ti.
an5.180:7.3: Alattha kho Ānanda Gavesī upāsako Kassapassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
an5.180:7.4: Acirūpasampanno kho pan' Ānanda Gavesī bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirass'eva yass' atthāya kulaputtā samma-d-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi,
an5.180:7.5: ‘khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā' ti abbhaññāsi,
an5.180:7.6: aññataro ca pan' Ānanda Gavesī bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosi.
an5.180:8.1: Atha kho Ānanda tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etad ahosi
an5.180:8.2: ‘ayyo kho Gavesī amhākaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā.
an5.180:8.3: ayyo hi nāma Gavesī kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati,
an5.180:8.5: Atha kho Ānanda tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena Kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Kassapaṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etad avocuṃ:--
an5.180:8.6: Labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjam, labheyyāma upasampadan ti.
an5.180:8.7: Alabhiṃsu kho Ānanda tāni pañca upāsakasatāni Kassapassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike pabbajjaṃ, alabhiṃsu upasampadaṃ.
an5.180:9.1: Atha kho Ānanda Gavesissa bhikkhuno etad ahosi
an5.180:9.2: ‘ahaṃ kho imassa anuttarassa vimuttisukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an5.180:9.3: aho vat'imāni pi pañca bhikkhusatāni imassa anuttarassa vimuttisukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhino' ti.
an5.180:9.4: Atha kho Ānanda tāni pañca bhikkhusatāni vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharantā na cirass'eva yass atthāya kulaputtā samma-d-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ
an5.180:9.5: brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihariṃsu,
an5.180:9.6: ‘khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā' ti abbhaññiṃsu. 3.
an5.180:10.1: Iti kho Ānanda tāni pañca bhikkhusatāni Gavesipamukhāni uttaruttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ vāyamamānā anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ sacchākaṃsu.
an5.180:10.2: Tasmā ti ha Ānanda evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ:-- 4.
an5.180:10.3: Uttaruttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ vāyamamānā anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ sacchikarissāmā ti. Evaṃ
